create_HOOKS_TRACKER: create a HooksTracker to track call order of composer environment callbacks during testing
test_HOOKS_TRACKER_assertions: test the HooksTracker assertHooksCalledOnce and assertHooksNotCalled methods to verify callback invocation counts
build_TRACKED_ENTITY: build a TrackedEntity subclass to track composer entity callback call order in test scenarios
create_TRACKED_TASK: create a TrackedTask with physics and control timesteps to track task-level composer callbacks
use_HOOKS_TEST_MIXIN: use the HooksTestMixin to set up tracked entities and run episodes with callback tracking enabled
